faults.quote: Hollis Bay's two largest retail partners have agreed to stock the line in all their stores, provided Hollis Bay pays the shelf fees.
faults.why: The candidate also asked for turns per store per week. Store velocity isn't held, but the interviewer never said 'I don't have' it. Planning assumptions only cover volume per household, so the velocity ask got no word.
The candidate said 'I'm done — can we do another case?' The interviewer kept probing and said nothing about that question.

faults.quote: Of the risks you named, which one would do the most damage to the break-even, and what would you do in the launch plan to guard against it?
faults.why: The candidate had just named a single risk (conversion shortfall) and given the mitigation (regional pilot), and had already covered how to test conversion at t9. The follow-up re-asks what was just answered.
